verses.original: יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה וְגַֽם־ כָּתַב֙ אִגְּרוֹת֙ עַל־ אֶפְרַ֣יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָב֥וֹא לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yiš·laḥ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh wə·ḡam- kā·ṯaḇ ’ig·gə·rō·wṯ ‘al- ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh lā·ḇō·w lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim la·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah sent word throughout all Israel and Judah and he also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh inviting them to come to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem to keep the Passover of the LORD the God of Israel

verses.original: הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֛יו וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּוָּעַ֨ץ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הַפֶּ֖סַח הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃ בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ wə·śā·rāw wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl bî·rū·šā·lim way·yiw·wā·‘aṣ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hap·pe·saḥ haš·šê·nî ba·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: For the king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem had decided to keep the Passover in the second month

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יָכְל֛וּ לַעֲשֹׂת֖וֹ הַהִ֑יא כִּ֤י בָּעֵ֣ת לֹֽא־ לְמַדַּ֔י הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ וְהָעָ֖ם לֹא־ נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·ḵə·lū la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw ha·hî kî bā·‘êṯ lō- lə·mad·day hak·kō·hă·nîm hiṯ·qad·də·šū wə·hā·‘ām lō- ne·’es·p̄ū lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: since they had been unable . . . to keep it at the regular . . . time because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not been gathered in Jerusalem

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֖ר וַיִּישַׁ֥ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār way·yî·šar bə·‘ê·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê kāl- haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: This plan pleased . . . the king and the whole assembly

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲמִ֣ידוּ דָבָ֗ר לְהַעֲבִ֨יר ק֤וֹל בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִבְּאֵֽר־ שֶׁ֣בַע וְעַד־ דָּ֔ן לָב֞וֹא לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּ֛סַח לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א עָשׂ֖וּ לָרֹ֛ב כַּכָּתֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū ḏā·ḇār lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr qō·wl bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl mib·bə·’êr- še·ḇa‘ wə·‘aḏ- dān lā·ḇō·w la·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl bî·rū·šā·lim kî lō ‘ā·śū lā·rōḇ kak·kā·ṯūḇ
verses.literal: So they established a decree to circulate a proclamation throughout Israel vvv from Beersheba to Dan that the people should come to keep the Passover of the LORD the God of Israel in Jerusalem For they had not observed it in great numbers as prescribed

verses.original: וּכְמִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הָרָצִ֨ים וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה בָּֽאִגְּר֜וֹת מִיַּ֧ד הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֗יו לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיָשֹׁב֙ אֶל־ הַנִּשְׁאֶ֣רֶת לָכֶ֔ם הַפְּלֵיטָ֔ה מִכַּ֖ף מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ hā·rā·ṣîm way·yê·lə·ḵū bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh bā·’ig·gə·rō·wṯ mî·yaḏ ham·me·leḵ wə·śā·rāw lê·mōr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl šū·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·šōḇ ’el- han·niš·’e·reṯ lā·ḵem hap·pə·lê·ṭāh mik·kap̄ mal·ḵê ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: At the command of the king the couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and his officials which read Children of Israel return to the LORD the God of Abraham Isaac and Israel so that He may return to those of you who remain who have escaped the grasp of the kings of Assyria

verses.original: וְאַל־ תִּֽהְי֗וּ כַּאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְכַ֣אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲל֔וּ בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְּנֵ֣ם לְשַׁמָּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tih·yū ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·ḵa·’ă·ḥê·ḵem ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem way·yit·tə·nêm lə·šam·māh ka·’ă·šer ’at·tem rō·’îm
verses.literal: Do not be like your fathers and brothers who were unfaithful to the LORD the God of their fathers so that He made them an object of horror as you can see

verses.original: עַתָּ֕ה אַל־ תַּקְשׁ֥וּ עָרְפְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם תְּנוּ־ יָ֣ד לַיהוָ֗ה וּבֹ֤אוּ לְמִקְדָּשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֣ישׁ לְעוֹלָ֔ם וְעִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ וְיָשֹׁ֥ב מִכֶּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ’al- taq·šū ‘ā·rə·pə·ḵem ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem tə·nū- yāḏ Yah·weh ū·ḇō·’ū lə·miq·dā·šōw ’ă·šer hiq·dîš lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw wə·yā·šōḇ mik·kem
verses.literal: Now do not stiffen your necks as your fathers [did] Submit . . . to the LORD and come to His sanctuary which He has consecrated forever Serve - the LORD your God so that His fierce anger . . . will turn away from you

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְשׁוּבְכֶ֞ם עַל־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲחֵיכֶ֨ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֤ם לְרַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י שֽׁוֹבֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָשׁ֖וּב הַזֹּ֑את לָאָ֣רֶץ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ וְלֹא־ פָּנִים֙ יָסִ֤יר מִכֶּ֔ם אִם־ תָּשׁ֖וּבוּ אֵלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·šū·ḇə·ḵem ‘al- Yah·weh ’ă·ḥê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem lə·ra·ḥă·mîm lip̄·nê šō·w·ḇê·hem wə·lā·šūḇ haz·zōṯ lā·’ā·reṣ kî- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ḥan·nūn wə·ra·ḥūm wə·lō- pā·nîm yā·sîr mik·kem ’im- tā·šū·ḇū ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: For if you return to the LORD your brothers and sons will receive mercy in the presence of their captors and will return to this land For the LORD your God is gracious and merciful He will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֨וּ הָרָצִ֜ים עֹבְרִ֨ים מֵעִ֧יר׀ לָעִ֛יר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְעַד־ זְבֻל֑וּן וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ מַשְׂחִיקִ֣ים עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמַלְעִגִ֖ים בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū hā·rā·ṣîm ‘ō·ḇə·rîm mê·‘îr lā·‘îr bə·’e·reṣ- ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh wə·‘aḏ- zə·ḇu·lūn way·yih·yū maś·ḥî·qîm ‘ă·lê·hem ū·mal·‘i·ḡîm bām
verses.literal: And the couriers traveled from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun . . . but the people scorned . . . and mocked them

verses.original: אַךְ־ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מֵאָשֵׁ֥ר וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִזְּבֻל֑וּן נִֽכְנְע֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ’ă·nā·šîm mê·’ā·šêr ū·mə·naš·šeh ū·miz·zə·ḇu·lūn niḵ·nə·‘ū way·yā·ḇō·’ū lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Nevertheless some from Asher Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem

verses.original: גַּ֣ם יַ֣ד הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים הָֽיְתָה֙ לָהֶ֖ם בִּיהוּדָ֗ה לָתֵ֥ת אֶחָ֑ד לֵ֣ב לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֖ים בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam yaḏ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·yə·ṯāh lā·hem bî·hū·ḏāh lā·ṯêṯ ’e·ḥāḏ lêḇ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miṣ·waṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moreover the power of God was on the people in Judah to give them one heart to obey the command of the king and his officials according to the word of the LORD

verses.original: הַשֵּׁנִ֑י בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ מְאֹֽד׃ לָרֹ֥ב קָהָ֖ל עַם־ רָ֔ב וַיֵּֽאָסְפ֤וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת־ חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: haš·šê·nî ba·ḥō·ḏeš mə·’ōḏ lā·rōḇ qā·hāl ‘am- rāḇ way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū yə·rū·šā·lim la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: In the second month a very great assembly . . . . . . gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate - the Feast of Unleavened Bread

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֕מוּ וַיָּסִ֙ירוּ֙ אֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הֵסִ֔ירוּ הַֽמְקַטְּרוֹת֙ וַיַּשְׁלִ֖יכוּ קִדְרֽוֹן׃ לְנַ֥חַל
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū way·yā·sî·rū ’eṯ- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim wə·’êṯ kāl- hê·sî·rū ham·qaṭ·ṭə·rō·wṯ way·yaš·lî·ḵū qiḏ·rō·wn lə·na·ḥal
verses.literal: They proceeded to remove - the altars - in Jerusalem - - and to take away the incense altars and throw them into the Kidron Valley

verses.original: בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַפֶּ֔סַח וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם נִכְלְמוּ֙ וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ עֹל֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār haš·šê·nî la·ḥō·ḏeš way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hap·pe·saḥ wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim niḵ·lə·mū way·yiṯ·qad·də·šū way·yā·ḇî·’ū ‘ō·lō·wṯ bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And on the fourteenth . . . day of the second month they slaughtered the Passover lamb The priests and Levites were ashamed and they consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַמְד֤וּ עַל־ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם עָמְדָם֙ כְּתוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ זֹרְקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם מִיַּ֖ד הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- kə·miš·pā·ṭām ‘ā·mə·ḏām kə·ṯō·w·raṯ mō·šeh ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hak·kō·hă·nîm zō·rə·qîm ’eṯ- had·dām mî·yaḏ hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: They stood at their prescribed posts according to the Law of Moses the man of God The priests splattered - the blood [which they received] from the hand of the Levites

verses.original: כִּי־ רַבַּ֥ת בַּקָּהָ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם עַל־ שְׁחִיטַ֣ת הַפְּסָחִ֗ים לְכֹל֙ לֹ֣א טָה֔וֹר לְהַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rab·baṯ baq·qā·hāl ’ă·šer lō- hiṯ·qad·dā·šū wə·hal·wî·yim ‘al- šə·ḥî·ṭaṯ hap·pə·sā·ḥîm lə·ḵōl lō ṭā·hō·wr lə·haq·dîš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Since there were many in the assembly who had not consecrated themselves the Levites were in charge of slaughtering the Passover lambs for every unclean person . . . to consecrate [the lambs] to the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַרְבִּ֣ית הָעָ֡ם רַ֠בַּת מֵֽאֶפְרַ֨יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה יִשָּׂשכָ֤ר וּזְבֻלוּן֙ לֹ֣א הִטֶּהָ֔רוּ כִּֽי־ אָכְל֥וּ אֶת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בְּלֹ֣א כַכָּת֑וּב כִּי֩ יְחִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ הִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֥ה הַטּ֖וֹב יְכַפֵּ֥ר בְּעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî mar·bîṯ hā·‘ām rab·baṯ mê·’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh yiś·śā·š·ḵār ū·zə·ḇu·lūn lō hiṭ·ṭe·hā·rū kî- ’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bə·lō ḵak·kā·ṯūḇ kî yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū hiṯ·pal·lêl ‘ă·lê·hem lê·mōr Yah·weh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ yə·ḵap·pêr bə·‘aḏ
verses.literal: A large number of the people many from Ephraim Manasseh Issachar and Zebulun had not purified themselves yet they ate - the Passover contrary to what was written But Hezekiah interceded for them saying May the LORD who is good provide atonement for everyone

verses.original: כָּל־ הֵכִ֔ין לְבָב֣וֹ לִדְר֛וֹשׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֑יו וְלֹ֖א כְּטָהֳרַ֥ת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- hê·ḵîn lə·ḇā·ḇōw liḏ·rō·wōš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāw wə·lō kə·ṭā·ho·raṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: who sets his heart on seeking God the LORD the God of his fathers even if [he is] not [cleansed] according to the purification rules of the sanctuary

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּרְפָּ֖א אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yiš·ma‘ yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yir·pā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . heard Hezekiah and healed - the people

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצְאִ֨ים בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת־ וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ חַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים גְדוֹלָ֑ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה הַלְוִיִּ֧ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וּֽמְהַלְלִ֣ים לַ֠יהוָה י֣וֹם׀ בְּי֞וֹם עֹ֖ז בִּכְלֵי־ לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl han·nim·ṣə·’îm bī·rū·šå̄·lam ’eṯ- way·ya·‘ă·śū ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh bə·śim·ḥāh hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ū·mə·hal·lîm Yah·weh yō·wm bə·yō·wm ‘ōz biḵ·lê- Yah·weh
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . who were present in Jerusalem - celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great joy and the Levites and priests praised the LORD day after day accompanied by loud instruments [of praise] to the LORD

verses.original: יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר עַל־ לֵב֙ כָּל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֥ים שֵֽׂכֶל־ ט֖וֹב לַיהוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֔ים וַיֹּאכְל֤וּ אֶת־ הַמּוֹעֵד֙ מְזַבְּחִים֙ שְׁלָמִ֔ים זִבְחֵ֣י וּמִ֨תְוַדִּ֔ים לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·ḏab·bêr ‘al- lêḇ kāl- hal·wî·yim ham·maś·kî·lîm śê·ḵel- ṭō·wḇ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm way·yō·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ham·mō·w·‘êḏ mə·zab·bə·ḥîm šə·lā·mîm ziḇ·ḥê ū·miṯ·wad·dîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: And Hezekiah encouraged . . . . . . all the Levites . . . who performed skillfully . . . before the LORD For seven days they ate - their assigned portion sacrificing peace offerings and giving thanks to the LORD the God of their fathers

verses.original: כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֔ל וַיִּוָּֽעֲצוּ֙ לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲחֵרִ֑ים יָמִ֖ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ שִׁבְעַת־ יָמִ֖ים שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- haq·qā·hāl way·yiw·wā·‘ă·ṣū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·ḥê·rîm yā·mîm way·ya·‘ă·śū šiḇ·‘aṯ- yā·mîm śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: The whole assembly agreed to observe seven more days so they observed seven days with joy

verses.original: כִּ֣י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְ֠הוּדָה הֵרִ֨ים אֶ֣לֶף פָּרִים֮ וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֣ים צֹאן֒ס לַקָּהָ֜ל וְהַשָּׂרִ֞ים הֵרִ֤ימוּ אֶ֔לֶף פָּרִ֣ים עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְצֹ֖אן לַקָּהָל֙ לָרֹֽב׃ כֹהֲנִ֖ים וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ
verses.transliteration: kî ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh hê·rîm ’e·lep̄ pā·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ṣō·ns laq·qā·hāl wə·haś·śā·rîm hê·rî·mū ’e·lep̄ pā·rîm ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ṣōn laq·qā·hāl lā·rōḇ ḵō·hă·nîm way·yiṯ·qad·də·šū
verses.literal: For Hezekiah king of Judah contributed a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep for the assembly and the officials contributed a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep for the assembly and a great number of priests consecrated themselves

verses.original: כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה וַֽיִּשְׂמְח֣וּ׀ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל הַבָּאִ֣ים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַגֵּרִ֗ים הַבָּאִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִ֖ים בִּיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- qə·hal yə·hū·ḏāh way·yiś·mə·ḥū wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl hab·bā·’îm mî·yiś·rā·’êl wə·hag·gê·rîm hab·bā·’îm mê·’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl wə·hay·yō·wō·šə·ḇîm bî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Then the whole assembly of Judah rejoiced along with the priests and Levites and the whole assembly that had come from Israel including the foreigners who had come vvv from Israel and those who lived in Judah

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֥י גְדוֹלָ֖ה שִׂמְחָֽה־ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֠י לֹ֥א כָזֹ֖את בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס מִימֵ֞י שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן־ דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh śim·ḥāh- bî·rū·šā·lim kî lō ḵā·zōṯ bî·rū·šā·lim mî·mê šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wîḏ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So there was great rejoicing in Jerusalem for nothing like this [had happened] [there] since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַלְוִיִּם֙ וַיָּקֻ֜מוּ וַיְבָרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וַיִּשָּׁמַ֖ע בְּקוֹלָ֑ם תְפִלָּתָ֛ם וַתָּב֧וֹא לִמְע֥וֹן קָדְשׁ֖וֹ לַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim way·yā·qu·mū way·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·yiš·šā·ma‘ bə·qō·w·lām ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯām wat·tā·ḇō·w lim·‘ō·wn qā·ḏə·šōw laš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then the priests and the Levites stood to bless - the people and God heard their voice and their prayer came into His holy dwelling place in heaven
